data.name: Eldritch Intuition
data.description: An eldritch raider gains an intuitive sense that allows her to more easily activate sorcerer and wizard spell completion and spell trigger items. She gains a +%1 bonus on Use Magic Device checks for this purpose.|RogueLVL/3
